title: Rav Povarsky's New Elevator
body: Rav Berel Povarsky's home now features a newly installed elevator, completed just hours before a late-Thursday-night gathering of Gedolei Yisroel, including Rav Dov Landau and Rav Moshe Hillel Hirsch.

title: Porush Defends Yeshiva Students
body: UTJ MK Meir Porush invoked David Ben-Gurion's legacy to defend yeshiva students, criticizing the legal establishment in a Knesset memorial session.
